item.name: config
item.item:
What you choose here is the order customers see under "Populärt" (the default sort on the shop). Customers never see the name of the option.

  • Standard – Same as today. Products follow their position numbers, lowest first (-8, -5, -1, 0 …). ShelfSense does not touch this category.
  • Newest first – The product added last comes first (highest product ID first).
  • Most relevant (smart) – Each product gets a score. 50% sales (last 90 days, the last 30 days count double), 25% how new it is (the boost halves every 30 days), 25% your own position numbers. Highest score comes first. Good when you want best sellers on top but still give new products and your own choices a chance.
  • Best sellers – Most units sold in the last 90 days first. Cancelled and refunded items do not count. All sizes of a product count together. All countries count together.

In all options except Standard, sold out products go last (can be turned off in settings).

The order is updated when you save the category and again every night. If you go back to Standard, your old position numbers come back exactly.

settings.label: Pinned SKUs on top (optional)
settings.notice: Products you always want first. Write one SKU per line. Example for 3 products: write 3 lines, and the first line is shown first. There is no limit. Pinned products go above everything else (sales, newest, score). The rest is sorted by the option above. Use the SKU of the product in this category (for products with sizes: the main SKU). SKUs that are not in this category are ignored. If a pinned product is sold out, it goes last until it is back in stock. Only works when "Sort products by" is not Standard.
